senses.gloss: m. (preced. ws.) age of majority (of females).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:2:13">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵇ</cite> <he>ימות הב׳</he> the period of majority. Y. B. Bath. IX, beg. 16ᵈ.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 4a:18">Kidd. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ דאיילונית</he> majority of a barren (or wombless) woman (who has no signs of maturity and becomes of age at twenty years).
<cite ref="Ketubot 38b:10">Keth. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>יש ב׳ בקבר</he> can the legal consequences of becoming of age enter after the woman’s death? [Other form: <cite ref="B00210"><he>בּוֹגֶר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:3:2">Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ</cite> <he>לאחר בּוֹגְרָהּ</he> after her becoming of age.] V. <cite ref="B00092"><he>בַּגְרוּת</he></cite>.
